text:
joel_csm: Heads-up: Medica onboarding flagged — token spend +25% WoW and two nightly surge windows causing p95 spikes. Theyre on hosted trial, renewal interest but fragile. Seeing large system prompts + iterative reranks. Thinking proactive: dark-launch compact-6b-int4 for rerank endpoints + schedule routing of surge windows to cheaper variant or reserved pool if they sign a short commit. Thoughts?
tara_ml: Can you share the tail numbers?
joel_csm: p50 baseline ~110ms, current p50 ~300ms; p95 ~950ms; p99 ~1800ms. Peak windows 23:00-23:45 UTC and 07:00-07:30 UTC. ~28% of requests >3.2k tokens, rerank-heavy.
ben_se: Budget status? Any committed dollars?
joel_csm: Hosted trial, no commit. Renewal signal = medium-low; they're cautious about latency and cost.
tara_ml: Plan outline: 1) Prefix/KV caching for repeated system instructions. 2) Dark-launch compact-6b-int4 (shadow traffic + mirrored eval) for rerank flow. 3) Schedule a routing rule to prefer compact-6b-int4 during surge windows; fallback to standard model. 4) Offer reserved-pool binding as optional if they commit to a 1-month trial.
joel_csm: Solid. Customer wants a low-risk path and measurable KPI improvements. Can we provide an actionable checklist + quick CLI snippets they can paste?
tara_ml: Yes. Quality gating: run mirrored requests (shadow) and compare embedding cosine similarity and top-k rerank order. Automatic rollback trigger if semantic-similarity drop > 2% or NDCG@10 drop > 1.5%.
ben_se: I'll draft the enablement checklist and include monitoring dashboards + Slack alerts. Also surface a short prompt-trim doc so we can reduce context length safely.
joel_csm: Phased proposal?
tara_ml: Phase 0: telemetry + prefix-caching for 48h. Phase 1 (dark launch): mirror 10% traffic to compact-6b-int4 for 24h (no user-visible swap) and run automated quality checks. Phase 2 (canary): 5% live traffic shift for 24-48h with rollback gates. Phase 3: scale to 30-50% and enable scheduled routing during surge windows. Reserve-pool option parallel if they sign commit.
ben_se: For dark-launch we need to ensure logs capture original and candidate outputs for diffing. Also synthetic load generator for 3k+ contexts. I'll prepare the harness.
joel_csm: Can we include estimated savings? Quick back-of-envelope: int4 compact ~ -32% token CPU cost on rerank slice; latency p95 for long contexts improves ~30-45%. If they migrate 40% of rerank traffic to compact, expect ~ -10% overall token spend and p95 drop ~20%. I'll caveat as estimate pending sim.
tara_ml: Routing snippet they can paste into Console API:```json
{
  "route": "medica-prod/rerank",
  "schedule": [
    {"window": "23:00-23:45", "preferred": "compact-6b-int4", "fallback": "open-13b-fp16"},
    {"window": "07:00-07:30", "preferred": "compact-6b-int4", "fallback": "open-13b-fp16"},
    {"window": "default", "preferred": "open-13b-fp16"}
  ],
  "dark_launch": {"mirror_to": "compact-6b-int4", "mirror_rate_pct": 10}
}
```
joel_csm: CLI quickstart for canary + enabling int4 profile:```bash
# enable prefix caching
redwood caching enable --prefix-kv --ttl 3600
# create dark-launch mirror
redwood routes mirror medica-prod/rerank --to compact-6b-int4 --pct 10
# create canary
redwood routes update medica-prod/rerank --canary-model compact-6b-int4 --canary-traffic 5
# set model execution profile to int4
redwood models set-execution-profile compact-6b-int4 --profile int4-fast
```
ops-bot: Note: binding reserved pools requires billing approval and quota checks. Any reserved-pool changes will open a finance PR.
tara_ml: Good note. We'll keep reserved-pool actions manual and include that in the runbook. For hosted fallback we'll rely on explicit fallback model in routing.
ben_se: I'll attach the runbook, rollback playbook, and suggested eval prompts (10 seeds + 20 edge rerank cases). Also include a short A/B dashboard to monitor NDCG, semantic-sim, latency, and token cost.
joel_csm: Customer requested a one-page risk assessment and the phased steps with dates. Can we finalize and send by EOD? I can run a 30m enablement call tomorrow at 10am UTC.
tara_ml: I'll run a 5k simulated workload against compact-6b-int4 and post aggregated numbers here in ~2h.
ben_se: Drafting runbook now, will share link when ready.
joel_csm: Thanks team. Will confirm time with Medica and post acceptance after the call. :thumbsup:
